shortcut_name: certificate condition is exactly a triangle
evidence: gpt-oss-120b uses "edges" and adjacency masks; glm-5 comments "Check for a triangle (Type 1)"; deepseek-v4-flash tests "w in adj[u] and w in adj[v]"
affordance_in_statement: A certificate consists of exactly three distinct materials ... for any material in the trio, if it is mutually volatile with at least one of the other two materials in the trio, it must be mutually volatile with both of them.
removal_suggestion: None without changing the mathematical task: with three vertices, the stated non-inertness and symmetry rules are intrinsically equivalent to requiring all three pairwise volatile edges. Only a materially different certificate condition could remove this shortcut.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Reduces every valid certificate to a triangle and searches adjacency bitmasks, while sorting candidates for lexicographic output.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A certificate consists of exactly three distinct materials ... reactive symmetry

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Explicitly searches for the lexicographically first triangle.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A certificate consists of exactly three distinct materials ... if it is mutually volatile with at least one of the other two materials in the trio, it must be mutually volatile with both of them.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Enumerates u < v < w and checks all three adjacency relations, which directly finds the lexicographically smallest triangle.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A certificate consists of exactly three distinct materials ... there is at least one mutually volatile pair

common_affordance: The three-material certificate rules are intrinsically equivalent to finding a triangle in the undirected graph.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It searches for a triangle but appears to return the first one encountered rather than guaranteeing the lexicographically smallest valid triple, violating the immutable tie-break rule.

recommended_edit: No safe single wording edit exists: the shared shortcut is the structural content of the problem. To defeat these survivors, the certificate definition or required output would have to be changed, which would change the task.
